description: The authoritative Browser Player v1 capability and command matrix. The Host, the server, Studio and the documentation are generated from this file by scripts/generate-browser-capabilities.mjs. Do not restate it by hand.

capabilities.label: Image and video playback
capabilities.note: The shared Player Runtime plays them.

capabilities.label: Playlists and transitions
capabilities.note: The shared Player Runtime advances items and runs transitions.

capabilities.label: Layouts
capabilities.note: Layout zones render in the shared Player Runtime.

capabilities.label: Widgets
capabilities.note: Widgets and Widget components render in the shared Player Runtime.

capabilities.label: Content schedules chosen by the server
capabilities.note: The server selects the content. The Browser Player does not rank schedules.

capabilities.label: Takeovers
capabilities.note: The server selects a Takeover like any other content.

capabilities.label: Active hours and rest
capabilities.note: The shared active-hours policy runs in the browser, including while the server is unreachable. The browser shows the rest surface. It does not power off the display.

capabilities.label: Last verified content offline
capabilities.note: The last completely prepared activation continues while the server is unreachable.

capabilities.label: Choosing future content schedules offline
capabilities.note: The server chooses content. The Browser Player waits for the server to choose again.

capabilities.label: Persistent media cache
capabilities.note: Supported when the browser grants persistent storage. Otherwise the browser can remove downloaded content.

capabilities.label: Activity and proof of play
capabilities.note: The Browser Player reports the same Activity events as other Players. It keeps them in a durable local queue until the server accepts them.

capabilities.label: Identify, retry, skip, sync and reload
capabilities.note: The Browser Player runs the commands listed under Commands.

capabilities.label: Installed app
capabilities.note: Chrome and Microsoft Edge can install each Browser Player as its own app.

capabilities.label: Synchronized playback
capabilities.note: The Browser Player does not produce shared timeline anchors.

capabilities.label: Watch Live and screenshots
capabilities.note: A browser cannot capture its own display without a user prompt.

capabilities.label: Websites and YouTube
capabilities.note: Browser Player v1 has no isolated Website surface. The browser frame boundary is not weakened.

capabilities.label: Display control (CEC and DDC)
capabilities.note: A web page cannot control the display.

capabilities.label: Device restart
capabilities.note: A web page cannot restart the device.

capabilities.label: Player updates
capabilities.note: The server supplies the Browser Player. Update targeting excludes it.

capabilities.label: Operating system network setup
capabilities.note: A web page cannot change the network.

supported.label: Sync now
supported.note: Refreshes the manifest, the configuration and the server selection.

supported.label: Reload playback
supported.note: Activates the current content again from the start.

supported.label: Identify screen
supported.note: Shows the Screen name through the shared Runtime.

supported.label: Retry current item
supported.note: Asks the shared Runtime to restart the item on screen.

supported.label: Skip current item
supported.note: Asks the shared Runtime to advance to the next item.
